resources.string: Choose this device’s minimum and maximum refresh rates, up to 144 Hz. The highest supported mode within this range is requested without changing resolution. Videos keep their original frame rate. On Windows, monitor refresh changes require separate explicit consent and are disabled by default. Startup and shutdown never change the monitor refresh rate.
The current rate is outside the selected range. The display or system may limit it; unsupported modes are never forced.
The other bound adjusts when needed to keep the range valid. This setting belongs to this device.
Allow Kovelyx to change the Windows monitor refresh rate

Off by default to prevent temporary black screens and whole-desktop stutters. Leave off for normal playback; change your monitor refresh rate in Windows Settings instead. Turning this on allows system-wide display mode changes when you edit the range.
